extraction.name: ChartQA
extraction.description: A benchmark for question answering about charts with visual and logical reasoning
extraction.creator: Ahmed Masry, Do Xuan Long, Jia Qing Tan, Shafiq Joty, Enamul Hoque
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We crawled charts from four different sources: (i) Statista (statista.com), (ii) The Pew research (pewresearch.org), (iii) Our World In Data or OWID (ourworldindata.org), and (iv) Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development or OECD (oecd.org).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection includes chart images and their underlying data tables from four different online sources.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The collected data was preprocessed to extract the underlying data tables and metadata from the chart images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: We have two main annotations procedures: (i) collect human-authored QA pairs using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) and (ii) generate QA pairs from the Statista human-written summaries.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The generated questions are similar to the human-authored questions.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has a diverse range of topics including economy, health, and society.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has some limitations including the quality of the extracted data tables and the complexity of the questions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training and testing chart question answering models.
